description: Lists the semantic components a Polyxd document can use, with a one-line summary each. Pass "name" for one component's full definition: every prop and its type, which are required, when to use it and when not to, and how it renders.

name.description: A component name, e.g. "Choice", for its full definition.

name: polyxd_components

outputSchema.description: "component" when a name was given; "components" otherwise.

agent.description: How an agent operating the rendered screen should use it.

category.description: The component's kind: action, shell, structure, content, input, flow, layout, feedback.

name.description: The component's type name, the value of "component" in a document, e.g. "Choice".

props.description: Every prop, by name, as a JSON Schema. $refs point into the spec's common definitions (DynamicString, Binding, Options and so on).

required.description: The props a document must set.

shell.description: True for shell components, which frame a product's screens: authored once per product, never generated.

summary.description: What the component is for, in one line.

whenNotToUse.description: When not to, and what to use instead.

components.description: Every component, in the spec's order.

category.description: The component's kind: action, shell, structure, content, input, flow, layout, feedback.

name.description: The component's type name. Pass it back as "name" for the full definition.

shell.description: True for shell components: authored once per product, never generated. Use the others in generated screens.

title: List Polyxd components
